analysis_denominator.definition: supported or partially_supported cases with non-empty primary gold evidence
analysis_denominator.excluded_insufficient_handling: not scored as retrieval failures for headline primary-gold metrics
analysis_denominator.technical_missingness: successful-pair intersection; technical failures excluded without zero imputation

bootstrap_configuration.method: paired percentile bootstrap of case-level recall differences

conditions.R2: lexical + dense reciprocal-rank fusion (RRF = 1/(60 + lexical_rank) + 1/(60 + dense_rank)); top 4

metric_definitions.aggregate_primary_gold_chunk_recall_at_4: total retrieved primary-gold chunks divided by total primary-gold chunks across the headline denominator
metric_definitions.aggregate_primary_source_recall_at_4: total retrieved primary-gold sources divided by total primary-gold sources across the headline denominator
metric_definitions.hit_at_4: fraction of headline cases with at least one primary-gold chunk retrieved in the top four
metric_definitions.mcnemar: exact two-sided McNemar calculation over paired Hit@4 discordance
metric_definitions.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first retrieved primary-gold chunk; zero when none is retrieved
metric_definitions.paired_mean_chunk_recall_difference: case-level comparison recall minus R0 recall, averaged over the successful-pair intersection

stage_a_source_relationship: stage_a_retrieval.jsonl and stage_a_raw_results.jsonl are byte-identical aliases/copies; analysis reads stage_a_retrieval.jsonl only
